description: This file defines the NullLogger class in the Psr\Log namespace, which extends AbstractLogger to provide a no-operation logger implementation that can be used to avoid conditional logging in code.

classes.name: NullLogger
classes.description: A logger class that performs no operations, used to simplify logging logic by providing a default do-nothing implementation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Implements the log method from the AbstractLogger class, performing no action (noop).
